Adherent is also the Quills gild rank, so it is unavoidable for Mastery

disclosures.title: earning Quills standing
disclosures.body: Quills standing comes only from turning in Sentient Cores to Onkko: Intact 250, Exceptional 750, Flawless 1,500, and Narmer Isoplast 2,000. Rank 30 or gilded Amps can also be donated to Onkko for standing.

rows.note: 141,000 of it burns on rank-ups, 9,000 buys the three Prisms

rows.label: Operative

rows.note: 22,000 standing, 1 Gyromag Systems, 1 Vega Toroid, 100,000 cr

disclosures.title: the rest of the Quills catalogue
disclosures.body: Observer: Shraksun Scaffold and Juttni Brace, 1,500 standing. Adherent: Klebrik Scaffold and Lohrin Brace, 2,000. Instrument: Phahd Scaffold and Anspatha Brace, 2,500. None of them changes Mastery.

rows.note: 3,000 standing, Hand

disclosures.title: the rest of the Vox Solaris catalogue
disclosures.body: Agent: Exard Scaffold and Suo Brace. Hand: Dissic Scaffold and Plaga Brace. Instrument: Propa Scaffold and Certus Brace. Each is 3,000 standing, three times the Quills' Pencha and Clapkra, and none changes Mastery.

rows.label: assembled Amp
rows.note: one per bought Prism; the Mote Amp comes assembled

conditions: Little Duck offers the same Amp Assembly
bonuses: The Amp Assembly screen previews combinations of parts you do not own yet

conditions: Gilding needs Adherent with the Quills or Hand with Vox Solaris, and only a rank 30 Amp can be gilded
Gilding resets the Amp to rank 0 and only then does leveling earn Mastery, so every Prism is two trips to rank 30
bonuses: A rank 30 or gilded Amp donates to Onkko for Quills standing or to Little Duck for Vox Solaris standing

disclosures.title: Sirocco
disclosures.body: The wiki counts Sirocco as a ninth Mastery Amp alongside the seven Prisms and the Mote Amp. It comes already gilded on completing The New War, so it needs nothing here and is not one of these Prisms.
